TourlyFaq1.subtitle: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
TourlyFaq1.description: Find quick answers to common questions about tour booking, payments, cancellations, and travel requirements.

leftFaqs.question: What types of tour packages do you offer?
leftFaqs.answer: We offer a wide range of tour packages including domestic tours, international tours, honeymoon packages, family vacations, adventure tours, group tours and customized travel packages to suit your preferences and budget.

leftFaqs.question: How can I book a tour with Tourly?
leftFaqs.answer: You can easily book a tour online through our website by selecting your destination, choosing your preferred dates, and submitting an enquiry. Alternatively, you can call our travel consultants directly.

leftFaqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
leftFaqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, net banking, UPI, wire transfers, and popular digital wallets for secure and hassle-free transactions.

leftFaqs.question: Can I customize my travel package?
leftFaqs.answer: Yes, absolutely! We specialize in tailoring custom holiday itineraries based on your preferred travel dates, hotel preferences, budget, and specific activities.

leftFaqs.question: Do you provide international tour packages?
leftFaqs.answer: Yes, we offer comprehensive international tour packages to popular destinations including Europe, Dubai, Maldives, Bali, Thailand, Singapore, and more.

leftFaqs.question: What is included in a tour package?
leftFaqs.answer: Our standard packages typically include hotel accommodations, daily breakfast, airport transfers, guided sightseeing, and select entrance fees. Specific inclusions vary per package.

leftFaqs.question: Are flights and hotels included in the package?
leftFaqs.answer: Yes, our packages can be booked with or without flights. Premium 3-star, 4-star, and 5-star hotel stays with daily breakfast are standard inclusions.

leftFaqs.question: Do you offer honeymoon packages?
leftFaqs.answer: Yes! We design special romantic honeymoon packages featuring candle-lit dinners, private villas, spa vouchers, and personalized honeymoon surprises.

leftFaqs.question: Can I book a group tour for a large family or company?
leftFaqs.answer: Yes, we provide specialized group tours and corporate retreats for families, friend groups, and corporate teams with attractive group discounts.

rightFaqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
rightFaqs.answer: We provide flexible cancellation policies. Depending on the time of cancellation prior to departure, you may receive a full or partial refund minus nominal processing fees.

rightFaqs.question: Will I get a travel visa assistance?
rightFaqs.answer: Yes, our visa assistance team will guide you through document preparation, appointment scheduling, and visa submission for all international destinations.

rightFaqs.question: Is travel insurance included?
rightFaqs.answer: Comprehensive travel insurance can be bundled with any package covering medical emergencies, trip cancellations, lost baggage, and flight delays.

rightFaqs.question: Can I make changes to my booking after confirmation?
rightFaqs.answer: Yes, date modifications and itinerary adjustments can be requested subject to hotel and airline availability and applicable modification fees.

rightFaqs.question: What documents are required for international travel?
rightFaqs.answer: You will need a valid passport with at least 6 months validity from departure date, valid travel visas, flight tickets, and hotel reservation vouchers.

rightFaqs.question: How do I receive my booking confirmation?
rightFaqs.answer: Once payment is verified, you will immediately receive a digital booking confirmation receipt and detailed travel vouchers via email and WhatsApp.

rightFaqs.question: Do you offer airport pickup and drop services?
rightFaqs.answer: Yes, comfortable and private air-conditioned airport pickup and drop transfers are included in almost all of our curated vacation packages.

rightFaqs.question: Are there any hidden charges?
rightFaqs.answer: No, we believe in 100% pricing transparency. All taxes, government levies, and standard package inclusions are clearly outlined upfront.

TourlyPackages1.subtitle: OUR PACKAGES
TourlyPackages1.description: Discover handcrafted travel itineraries designed for comfort, luxury, and unmatched adventure.

packagesList.title: Bali Beach Holidays
packagesList.description: Relax on pristine beaches, explore ancient temples and enjoy the vibrant culture of Bali.
packagesList.shortDescription: Experience the perfect blend of pristine beaches, rich culture and stunning landscapes in this unforgettable Bali tour package.

overview.title: Package Overview
overview.description: Bali, the Island of Gods, is a dream destination known for its beautiful beaches, ancient temples, vibrant culture and breathtaking natural beauty. This 5 days / 4 nights package takes you through the best of Bali, including popular attractions, water activities, cultural experiences and leisure time to explore at your own pace. Discover majestic cliffside sanctuaries, unwind across sun-kissed coastlines, savor authentic local delicacies, and create unforgettable tropical holiday memories with our expert tour guides.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali – Airport Welcome & Hotel Check-in
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport, meet our representative and transfer to hotel. Check-in and relax. Evening free for leisure or explore nearby beach. Stroll along the sun-drenched sands of Kuta, witness a captivating Indian Ocean sunset, indulge in refreshing welcome tropical mocktails, and sample mouthwatering Balinese seafood at vibrant beachside cafes.

itinerary.title: Full Day Kintamani Volcano & Rice Terraces Tour
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, visit Kintamani Volcano, enjoy stunning views of Mount Batur and Lake Batur. Explore Tegalalang Rice Terraces and traditional villages. Return to hotel in the evening. Experience the authentic atmosphere of sacred Tirta Empul spring temple, capture picture-perfect moments at lush emerald slopes, and enjoy a scenic hillside coffee plantation tasting tour.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Cliff Temple & Sunset Kecak Tour
itinerary.desc: Visit the majestic Uluwatu Temple, enjoy stunning cliff views and witness a beautiful sunset. Optional Kecak dance performance in the evening. Marvel at dramatic coastal limestone cliffs towering over crashing surf, wander along ancient paved pathways, and conclude your evening with a candlelit fresh seafood dinner right on Jimbaran Beach.

itinerary.title: Tropical Island Excursion & Water Sports
itinerary.desc: Enjoy exciting water sports activities like snorkeling, banana boat ride and visit Nusa Penida or Nusa Lembongan Island. Discover vibrant coral reefs teeming with exotic marine wildlife, take an exhilarating speed boat ride, snap photographs at iconic Kelingking Beach, and swim in turquoise tidal lagoons.

itinerary.title: Souvenir Shopping & Airport Departure
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check-out from hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward journey with beautiful memories. Enjoy leisurely last-minute souvenir shopping at local handicraft art markets, pick up aromatic spices and handcrafted wood carvings, and take a smooth private transfer to the departure terminal.

inclusions: Return flight tickets (as per package)
4 nights accommodation in 3-star hotel
Daily breakfast at hotel
Airport transfers and sightseeing by private vehicle
All taxes and service charges

packagesList.title: Kashmir Valley Tour
packagesList.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Kashmir with snow-capped mountains and serene lakes.
packagesList.shortDescription: Explore Kashmir paradise on Earth with shikara rides on Dal Lake, snow meadows of Gulmarg, and scenic pine valleys of Pahalgam.

overview.title: Package Overview
overview.description: Kashmir Valley is a heaven on earth boasting mesmerizing Himalayan views, fragrant pine forests, sparkling crystal rivers, and traditional wooden houseboats. This 5 days / 4 nights journey connects the soul of Srinagar, Gulmarg's snow wonderland, and Pahalgam's valleys.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar – Dal Lake Shikara Ride
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Srinagar Sheikh ul-Alam Airport. Check-in to a luxury Dal Lake houseboat and enjoy an evening shikara cruise across floating markets.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg Day Trip
itinerary.desc: Drive through scenic pine valleys to Gulmarg. Experience the world famous Gondola cable car ride up to Kongdoori and Apharwat Peak.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Valley Excursion
itinerary.desc: Full day tour to Pahalgam (Valley of Shepherds). Visit Betaab Valley, Aru Valley and stroll along the roaring Lidder River.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Mughal Gardens & Heritage Walk
itinerary.desc: Tour the historic Mughal Gardens including Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, and Shankaracharya Temple.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.desc: After traditional breakfast and Kehwa tea, transfer to Srinagar airport for your flight home with treasured memories.

inclusions: 1 night stay in premium Dal Lake Houseboat
3 nights stay in 3-star hotel in Srinagar
Daily breakfast and dinner (MAP plan)
1 hour complimentary Shikara ride on Dal Lake
All transfers and sightseeing by private dedicated cab
Toll taxes, driver allowances and parking charges
exclusions: Gondola cable car tickets in Gulmarg
Pony ride and local union vehicle charges in Pahalgam
Entry tickets to monuments and gardens

packagesList.title: Europe Dream Tour
packagesList.description: Explore iconic cities, world-famous landmarks and create memories for a lifetime.
packagesList.shortDescription: Discover the best of Europe across France, Switzerland and Italy with Eiffel Tower, Swiss snow peaks and Venice canals.

overview.title: Package Overview
overview.description: Embark on an unforgettable grand voyage through Western Europe. Marvel at the sparkling Eiffel Tower in Paris, scale snow-clad Mount Titlis in Switzerland, cruise the ancient canals of Venice, and step back in time at Rome's Colosseum.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Paris – City of Lights
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Paris, transfer to your hotel and unwind. Evening Seine River sightseeing cruise showcasing illuminated landmarks.

itinerary.title: Paris Sightseeing & Eiffel Tower
itinerary.desc: Visit Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, Louvre exterior, and ascend the 2nd level of the Eiffel Tower for panoramic views.

itinerary.title: Paris to Swiss Alps via TGV Train
itinerary.desc: Board the high-speed train to Switzerland. Arrive in Lucerne, check-in to alpine hotel and enjoy Chapel Bridge walk.

itinerary.title: Mount Titlis Snow Mountain Excursion
itinerary.desc: Ride the world's first revolving cable car to Mount Titlis summit. Explore the Glacier Cave and cross the Cliff Walk.

itinerary.title: Switzerland to Venice, Italy
itinerary.desc: Cross the scenic Alps into Venice. Check-in, take a romantic water taxi to St. Mark's Square and Basilica.

itinerary.title: Venice to Rome via Florence
itinerary.desc: Morning Gondola ride in Venice, then train to Rome with a photo stop in Florence to view the Cathedral and Ponte Vecchio.

itinerary.title: Colosseum & Roman Forum Tour
itinerary.desc: Guided walking tour through ancient Rome, the mighty Colosseum, Roman Forum and the Pantheon.

itinerary.title: Vatican City & Trevi Fountain
itinerary.desc: Explore St. Peter's Basilica and Vatican Museums. Toss a coin at Trevi Fountain for good fortune.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day in Rome
itinerary.desc: Free day to shop designer boutiques on Via del Corso or relax in quaint cafes enjoying espresso and gelato.

itinerary.title: Departure from Rome
itinerary.desc: Check-out and private transfer to Rome Fiumicino Airport for your journey home with magnificent stories.

inclusions: International roundtrip airfare with baggage
9 nights accommodation in 4-star hotels with breakfast
High-speed Euro rail tickets between cities
Eiffel Tower Level 2 & Mount Titlis cable car tickets
Guided sightseeing in Paris, Lucerne, Venice and Rome
Schengen tourist visa documentation assistance
exclusions: City tourist taxes (payable directly at hotel receptions)

packagesList.title: Thailand Island Tour
packagesList.description: Enjoy crystal clear waters, golden beaches and exciting city tours in Thailand.
packagesList.shortDescription: Experience vibrant Thailand with turquoise island hopping in Phuket & Krabi, thrilling water sports and cultural temples of Bangkok.

overview.title: Package Overview
overview.description: Unwind in the Land of Smiles with this comprehensive Thailand escape. Sail on speedboats to the renowned Phi Phi Islands, marvel at Krabi's limestone cliffs, and indulge in world-class shopping and dining in bustling Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Phuket – Resort Check-in
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Phuket International Airport, meet representative and transfer to beachfront resort. Evening at Patong Beach.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Island Speedboat Adventure
itinerary.desc: Exciting speedboat trip to Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Monkey Beach and Pileh Lagoon with buffet lunch.

itinerary.title: Phuket to Krabi by Scenic Ferry
itinerary.desc: Transfer to Krabi by sea ferry. Check-in to Ao Nang resort and spend the evening enjoying beachside cafes.

itinerary.title: Krabi Four Islands Tour
itinerary.desc: Visit Koh Poda, Chicken Island, Tup Island and Phra Nang Cave Beach with crystal water snorkeling.

itinerary.title: Flight to Bangkok & River Dinner Cruise
itinerary.desc: Fly from Krabi to Bangkok. Evening luxury dinner cruise along the Chao Phraya River with live entertainment.

itinerary.title: Bangkok City & Golden Buddha Temple Tour
itinerary.desc: Half-day cultural tour visiting Wat Traimit and Wat Benchamabophit, followed by shopping at MBK and Siam Paragon.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bangkok
itinerary.desc: Check-out and transfer to Suvarnabhumi Airport for your return flight home.

inclusions: Roundtrip international flight tickets
Domestic flight from Krabi to Bangkok
6 nights 4-star accommodation with daily breakfast
Full day Phi Phi Island tour with lunch by speedboat
Krabi Four Islands tour with snorkeling equipment
Bangkok river dinner cruise & city temple tour
All airport and ferry transfers in private AC vehicle
exclusions: Lunches and dinners not listed in inclusions

packagesList.title: Romantic Maldives Escape
packagesList.description: Indulge in private overwater villas, candle-lit beach dinners and turquoise lagoons.
packagesList.shortDescription: Ultimate luxury honeymoon in the Maldives with private overwater villa, private pool, coral reef snorkeling and sunset champagne cruise.

overview.title: Package Overview
overview.description: Escape to private tropical paradise where the ocean meets luxury. Stay suspended above pristine turquoise water in an overwater villa, plunge into coral gardens with colorful marine life, and celebrate love with bespoke romantic dinners right on the beach.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Male – Speedboat Transfer
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Velana International Airport. Meet resort representative for a breathtaking speedboat transfer to your private island resort.

itinerary.title: Water Villa Leisure & House Reef Snorkeling
itinerary.desc: Wake up to endless ocean vistas. Explore the vibrant house reef with complimentary snorkeling equipment and spot exotic marine life.

itinerary.title: Sunset Dolphin Watching & Candlelit Dinner
itinerary.desc: Late afternoon Dhoni cruise searching for playful spinner dolphins, followed by an intimate candlelit dinner on the beach.

itinerary.title: Couple Spa & Lagoon Water Sports
itinerary.desc: Indulge in a signature couple massage at the overwater spa pavilion. Afternoon sea kayaking and paddle boarding.

itinerary.title: Departure from Maldives
itinerary.desc: Enjoy a floating breakfast, check-out and board the speedboat transfer back to Male Airport for flight departure.

inclusions: International roundtrip flight tickets
4 nights stay in Luxury Overwater Villa with private deck
All-Inclusive meal plan (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner & Selected Drinks)
Roundtrip speedboat transfers from/to Male Airport
1 complimentary sunset dolphin cruise for couple
Free use of snorkeling equipment, kayaks & paddleboards
All resort service charges and Maldives Green Tax
exclusions: Motorized watersports (jet ski, flyboarding, seabed seabob)
Premium champagne and vintage cellared wines
A-la-carte spa treatments not included in package

packagesList.title: Dubai Family Extravaganza
packagesList.description: Burj Khalifa, Desert Safari, theme parks and luxury shopping for the entire family.
packagesList.shortDescription: The ultimate family holiday in Dubai with Burj Khalifa 124th floor observatory, thrilling 4x4 desert safari, theme parks and luxury marina cruise.

overview.title: Package Overview
overview.description: Discover a city of wonders where traditional Arabian hospitality meets modern architecture. From riding the golden sand dunes on a desert safari to touching the clouds at Burj Khalifa and shopping in giant malls, Dubai is the premier family destination.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai – Welcome & Check-in
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Dubai International Airport. Meet representative and transfer to your 4-star downtown hotel. Evening free to relax.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour & Marina Dhow Cruise
itinerary.desc: Guided city tour covering Dubai Museum, Jumeirah Beach, and Burj Al Arab photo stop. Evening Marina Dhow Cruise with buffet dinner.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner & Shows
itinerary.desc: Afternoon 4x4 Land Cruiser desert dune bashing, camel riding, sand boarding, tanoura dance show and Arabic BBQ dinner.

itinerary.title: Dubai Mall & Burj Khalifa 124th Floor
itinerary.desc: Explore Dubai Mall, watch the Dubai Dancing Fountain show, and take the high-speed elevator to Burj Khalifa 124th floor.

itinerary.title: Dubai Frame & Miracle Garden
itinerary.desc: Visit the Dubai Frame for old vs new Dubai views, followed by millions of blooming flowers at Dubai Miracle Garden.

itinerary.title: Souk Shopping & Departure
itinerary.desc: Explore the Gold Souk and Spice Souk for souvenirs, check-out and private transfer to airport for departure.

inclusions: International roundtrip flight tickets
5 nights accommodation in 4-star hotel with breakfast
Dubai tourist visa assistance & processing
Desert safari with 4x4 dune bashing & BBQ dinner buffet
Burj Khalifa 124th floor entry ticket (non-prime hours)
Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise with international buffet
All tours and airport transfers by private vehicle
exclusions: Tourism Dirham fee (approx AED 15/night payable at hotel)
Optional attractions like Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark
